about_the_game:
Building Management Simulation x Rogue-lite!

You are a rookie hired CEO.
"The fate of this building’s management is in your hands! You can turn things around, right!?"
Endure unreasonable demands from your boss and achieve your goals!
However, the orders keep escalating…!?
Overcome countless hardships and aim to become a tycoon!!

A Dynamic Business Environment!
The business environment changes every time, influenced by the foot traffic of existing buildings and stores.
You can only buy the random products selected by your boss—meaning free management is out of the question!?
Think strategically within your limited choices to find the best management strategy!

Sharpen Your Business Skills!
Upgrade products to improve their performance!
It’s up to you as the CEO to manage a cast of unique employees!
Use them efficiently to maximize your profits!
